The university going totally silent afterward is the giveaway that it's all staged from the start by the hidden elites really running these places. They're deliberately letting the story spread to divide people, whip up fake outrage, and bury any real questions about who actually controls education and power. That official silence isn't hesitation—it's the signal for them to spin the narrative and keep everyone distracted from the coordinated manipulation happening behind the scenes.
